name: Shinyuu no Shitai wo Sagashite
source:
My best friend vanished.

One day, she reappeared and said:
"Find my body."


A short visual novel where you go searching for your best friend's body on a summer evening. Slight horror elements, and selectable options that unlock four ending scenarios. A final scenario unlocks after completing all endings. 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14138]Novelgame[/url]]
